example: Before: Dull photo → After: Vibrant & crisp

prompt: Optional: e.g., 'place the subject on the left side'
whatItDoes: Swaps the background with a new one
example: Before: White wall → After: Cozy cafe
Before: Cluttered bg → After: Clean cutout

prompt: e.g., 'Place the vase on the coffee table'

description: Easily change hair style in images
prompt: e.g., 'Change my hair to platinum blonde' or 'Give me a curly bob'
whatItDoes: Changes hair color, style, or cut

description: Virtually try on clothes on a model or yourself.

description: Preview a tattoo on a model or your own photo.

description: Enter what you want to do with the image. You can also upload a second image.
prompt: e.g., 'Make this look like a vintage postcard' or 'add a pirate hat to the dog'

example: Make it warmer, add steam, etc.
